image_description: Three Star Trek comic books fanned out on a dark textured surface. The leftmost is 'Star Trek: The Next Generation' featuring Worf; the center is 'Star Trek: The Next Generation - Dixon Hill is on the Case' featuring a noir-style detective and woman; the rightmost is 'Star Trek: The Next Generation - Embrace the Wolf' featuring Sisko and a space scene. All covers show glossy printing, bold typography, and illustrated artwork.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Staple-bound periodical magazine with portrait-oriented rectangular proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All three items clearly exhibit the standard rectangular portrait aspect ratio of comic books. While staples aren't visible from this angle, the format matches.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Glossy color cover with illustrated artwork and bold title typography.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Covers are visibly glossy (reflections present), feature full-color illustrations, and have large, bold 'STAR TREK' titles.
The spines are facing away or obscured by the fanning arrangement; staple marks cannot be visually verified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Substantial page count with sequential panel layouts.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only front covers are visible; interior pages and panel layouts are completely occluded.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Hand-drawn or digitally rendered illustrations with speech bubbles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Cover art is clearly illustrated. Speech bubbles are not prominent on these specific covers (mostly title/character art), but the illustration style matches the checkpoint's artistic requirement.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Caption boxes and dialogue text within panels.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Interior panels containing dialogue/captions are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Slightly glossy paper stock with vibrant CMYK color printing.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Specular highlights confirm glossiness. Colors are vibrant and consistent with commercial CMYK printing standards.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Cover art exhibits dynamic character poses and action compositions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Characters are depicted in active or dramatic poses (e.g., Worf holding weapon, detective pointing). Compositions are dynamic.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Periodical format for serialized graphic storytelling.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Issue numbers (e.g., #43, #5) and series titles confirm these are part of a serialized periodical format.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The barcode numbers and small print near the bottom left are slightly blurred and indistinct, typical of AI generation struggling with fine alphanumeric details, though not completely nonsensical.
The dark background texture has a slight 'smudged' or painterly quality rather than distinct fabric weave, suggesting minor generative smoothing.

selected_experts.reason: To verify the specific sub-genre (Star Trek) and confirm the object class as 'comic book' rather than just 'magazine' or 'book'.
To rigorously check the legibility and correctness of the complex text on the covers (titles, author names, issue numbers), which is a high-risk area for AI artifacts.
To assess the global coherence, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle blending errors between the comics and the background.
To ensure the edges of the fanned comics are sharp and physically plausible, checking for any melting into the background or each other.

focus_areas: Text legibility and accuracy on covers
Edge sharpness and separation between overlapping comics
Consistency of lighting and shadows across the three objects
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text auditor's findings. AI often fails at rendering specific issue numbers and author names correctly. If the text is mostly legible but has minor kerning or glyph issues, note it as a low-severity artifact. Verify if the 'gloss' reflection is consistent across all three covers relative to a single light source.
